criteria.observation: The review groups evidenced changes in the original proposal by concrete impact and gives a supported severity and decision.
The reported paths exclude unchanged safe signals. Repetition or a warning on an allowed field earns no extra credit.
The repair provides a usable failure record for support while excluding raw sensitive fields. Complete masking and omission of those fields are equivalent.

Support can locate the failed request and its outcome using the repaired output, determine its error and latency, and retain the remaining valid diagnostics in order. The output also satisfies the published privacy contract.
Submitted original-versus-repaired observations identify retained diagnostics and malformed inputs and can be traced to the same event records.
